title: Nashville's Famous Loveless Cafe Stay
description:
The space
Private Garden Studio | WiFi & Kitchenette | Bellevue, Nashville, TN | Sleeps 2

Escape to your own peaceful hideaway in this charming private backyard studio in Nashville's Bellevue neighborhood, about 13 miles (20-25 min) from downtown Nashville. Tucked among lush greenery and bamboo, this cozy retreat offers a relaxing atmosphere that feels wonderfully removed from the everyday hustle and bustle.

Prime location
- Located in Bellevue, a quiet residential area on Nashville's west side
- About 13 miles / 20-25 minutes to downtown Nashville and Broadway
- Close to Bellevue's shops and restaurants along Highway 70S

Top amenities
- Studio with a comfortable bed, sleeps 2
- Bright interior with large windows overlooking the garden
- Private entrance
- Kitchenette
- Free WiFi
- Free parking on premise
- Private patio area for morning coffee, an afternoon read, or evening relaxing

The space
The bright, welcoming studio features a comfortable bed, large windows overlooking the surrounding greenery, and a warm, intimate interior that makes it easy to settle in and unwind. A kitchenette makes it easy to prepare a quick meal or morning coffee, and free WiFi keeps you connected throughout your stay. Step outside and enjoy your own inviting patio — a quiet spot to start or end the day.

Good for
- Couples
- Solo travelers
- Anyone wanting a quiet home base while exploring Nashville
